verdicts.note: Distinct requirement from A1 requiring the courtesy title ‘The Honourable’ for superior court judges.
Prescribes ‘Your Honour’, ‘His Honour’ or ‘Her Honour’ for judges of intermediate courts.
Mandates the complimentary close ‘Yours faithfully’ for correspondence to superior court judges.
Prescribes the specific address form for magistrates when addressing an envelope.
